title: YMCA

services.name: Group Lessons
services.desc: Our Parent/Child classes are for water acclimation of swimmers from 6 months to 3 years of age. We have 8-10 parent child pairs per class and do a mix of songs, activities, and instruction to gain comfort and swimming readiness. Parents accompany children in Parent/Child A, which introduces infants and toddlers to the aquatic environment through exploration. The course encourages children to enjoy themselves while learning about the water. Parents accompany their toddlers in Parent/Child B and work with their children to explore body positions, floating, blowing bubbles, and fundamental safety and aquatics skills. If you need assistance finding your child’s level, please visit our Swim
